page.overview:
Who is Blinky?

Blinky is a red ghost from the Pac-Man franchise. He is the leader of the other ghosts, Inky, Pinky, and Clyde, and together they oppose Pac-Man and Ms. Pac-Man. Blinky debuted in the same game as Pac-Man, simply titled Pac-Man. He has made some crossovers with Mario characters.

Blinky makes his Super Mario franchise debut in Mario Kart Arcade GP, where he, alongside Pac-Man and Ms. Pac-Man, appears as a playable character due to the game being developed by Bandai Namco Holdings. Blinky's special items are Monster Shield, Monster's Hammer, Petit Monster, Flare Ball, and Ghost Morph. His emblem is a sprite of himself from the Pac-Man arcade game. Blinky's arcade sprite also appears in the Pac Labyrinth course.

Blinky returns as a playable character in Mario Kart Arcade GP 2. In this game, when in his standard kart, he has exceptional acceleration, but poor weight and top speed, sharing these statistics with Peach and Yoshi. In his personal kart, Blinky has great acceleration, but poor weight and average top speed.

Although Blinky is no longer playable in Mario Kart Arcade GP DX, a sprite of him appears on the Pac-Man Stadium course, and he appears at the start of the Pac-Man Cup, along with the other ghosts, using their designs from the original Pac-Man arcade game.
